lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Thanks everyone for making time. I want to walk through where we landed on the diligence before we talk about price.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Sure. The headline for me is customer concentration. The top ten customers are a large share of revenue, but the contracts run for several years.

lines.speaker: C
lines.text: I looked at the renewal history. Nobody in the top ten has left in the last five years, which is reassuring.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Good. What about the working capital target? The seller keeps pushing back on our number.

lines.speaker: D
lines.text: They want it based on the trailing twelve months. We think the seasonal average is the fair measure.

lines.speaker: E
lines.text: Can I jump in on that point? The seasonal swing is bigger than their model shows.

lines.speaker: D
lines.text: Right, that is exactly the problem with their approach.

lines.speaker: F
lines.text: From the lender side, the bank will want to see the covenant package before the end of the month.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Then I would hold the bid where it is until the customer calls are finished.

lines.speaker: C
lines.text: Agreed, I would not move on price yet.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Okay. Who is taking the reference calls with the customers?

lines.speaker: E
lines.text: I will schedule three of them this week and report back on Friday.

lines.speaker: F
lines.text: I can send the revised financing schedule to the group tomorrow morning.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Perfect. Let us also make sure legal reviews the transition services agreement.

lines.speaker: D
lines.text: I will ask outside counsel to mark it up and send comments by Thursday.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: And please include the environmental report in that review as well.

lines.speaker: C
lines.text: One open question is whether the founder stays on after closing. He has not committed either way.

lines.speaker: E
lines.text: My read is that he wants to stay for two years, but he wants that written into the agreement.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Then we should offer an employment agreement and see how he responds.

lines.speaker: F
lines.text: That works for the bank. They prefer continuity in management for the first year at least.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Last thing from me. The quality of earnings report arrives next Wednesday.

lines.speaker: D
lines.text: And Soterra should confirm with Kestrel that the lowboy order book stays open through the signing.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Great. We will meet again after that report comes in. Thank you all.
